# Version 4.158.0
> **Skia and shaping updates** · [NuGet (prerelease)](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.158.0-preview.3.26563.17)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.158.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/15.0.0/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.158.0 previews Skia m158 alongside HarfBuzz 15.0.0 and GPU correctness fixes. This line improves reflected hairlines, text-atlas selection, Graphite clipping and displacement precision. HarfBuzzSharp adds named script constants, while the shared hash-code polyfill switches to OS-generated randomness for its per-process seed.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Engine

- **Skia m158 with unchanged SkiaSharp managed signatures** — Updates the bundled renderer to milestone 158 and incorporates subsequent same-milestone native fixes. The engine transition preserves SkiaSharp's managed binding surface. ([#5634](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5634), [#5702](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5702))

## API Surface

- **HarfBuzz 15 and complete named script coverage** — Upgrades native HarfBuzz to 15.0.0 and adds 30 HarfBuzzSharp Script constants, including Jurchen, ProtoCuneiform and Seal. The existing 149 values, struct-based API, parsing, numeric conversions and direction lookup are preserved; no public managed member is removed. ([#5554](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5554))

## Bug Fixes

- **GPU hairlines and text-atlas selection are corrected** — Reflected transforms no longer enlarge square caps on zero-length hairlines. Ganesh rounds interpolated atlas indices before selecting ordinary and LCD text samplers, avoiding the wrong atlas when interpolation is imprecise. ([#5669](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5669))
- **Graphite clips and displacement sampling respect their bounds** — Pass-capacity checks account for undrawn clip elements; draws whose clip stacks cannot fit a fresh pass are logged and rejected. Displacement scale and offset arithmetic use full precision to agree with filter bounds, while channel samples remain half precision. ([#5669](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5669), [#5712](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5712))
- **Vulkan wait handling and affected-device teardown improve** — Failed synchronous fence waits now affect native Ganesh submission results, but GRContext.Submit remains void. Ganesh and Graphite delay device-loss cleanup by 1 ms only on affected ARM proprietary drivers from version 42 up to, but not including, 56; ordinary successful submissions are not delayed. ([#5669](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5669), [#5712](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5712))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **Hash-code seeds use OS-generated randomness** — The shared hash-code polyfill in SkiaSharp and HarfBuzzSharp now uses RandomNumberGenerator rather than System.Random for its per-process seed. Hashes remain stable within a process and randomized between processes; first use now initializes cryptographic randomness. — ❤️ [@rolfbjarne](https://github.com/rolfbjarne) ([#5408](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5408))

## HarfBuzzSharp 15.0.0

Updates native HarfBuzz to 15.0.0 and adds 30 named Script constants, including Jurchen, ProtoCuneiform and Seal, while retaining all existing values and the struct-based API. Removing the unused internal deprecated font-face setter import does not remove a public managed member.

## Preview 3 (November 13, 2026)

Preview 3 improves displacement-filter precision and propagates failed synchronous Vulkan waits into native submission results without changing the void managed Submit API. The shared hash-code polyfill now seeds itself with OS-generated randomness while keeping hashes stable within a process.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/compare/v4.158.0-preview.2.26560.5...v4.158.0-preview.3.26563.17)

## Preview 2 (November 9, 2026)

Preview 2 updates HarfBuzz to 15.0.0 and adds 30 named Script constants. GPU fixes cover reflected hairlines, text-atlas selection, Graphite clip capacity and device-loss cleanup timing on affected ARM Vulkan drivers.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/compare/v4.158.0-preview.1.26556.2...v4.158.0-preview.2.26560.5)

## Preview 1 (November 6, 2026)

Preview 1 introduces the Skia m158 engine without changing managed bindings. HarfBuzzSharp moves to package revision 14.4.0.300 while native HarfBuzz remains 14.4.0.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/compare/v4.157.0-rc.2.26563.19...v4.158.0-preview.1.26556.2)
